pages.en: Today is Around the World Day at school. Every class has a country. Lily's class has Italy, and Mia's class has Japan.
pages.zh: 今天是学校的“环游世界日”。每个班都有一个国家。Lily 班上是意大利，Mia 班上是日本。
pages.scene: A colourful school hall with tables decorated with flags of many countries, Lily at a table with Italian flags and pizza, Mia at a table with Japanese cherry blossom pictures.

pages.en: Lily makes a pizza and learns some Italian words. Mia wears Japanese clothes. Sam's class has Brazil, and they play football.
pages.zh: Lily 做了一个披萨，还学了几个意大利语单词。Mia 穿着日本的传统服装。Sam 班上是巴西，他们踢起了足球。
pages.scene: Lily putting tomato on a pizza, Mia in a pretty kimono, Sam kicking a football with friends in yellow and green shirts in the school yard.

pages.en: At the end of the day, Lily looks at the big map of the world. "I want to visit every country," she says.
pages.zh: 一天结束时，Lily 看着那张大大的世界地图。“我想去每一个国家，”她说。
pages.scene: Lily standing in front of a big colourful map of the world on the school wall, pointing at the continents with a dreamy smile.

questions.q: Which country does Lily's class have?

questions.zh: Sam 班上下了国际象棋。
